scripts.db:clean: pnpm db:up && docker rm -f supertokens 2>/dev/null; ../../tools/scripts/drop_db.sh supertokens tactica_postgres_dev && ../../tools/scripts/drop_user.sh supertokens tactica_postgres_dev
scripts.db:restore-fixtures: pnpm db:clean && pnpm db:up && ../../tools/scripts/restore_fixtures.sh supertokens postgres://supertokens:supertokens_password@localhost:5432/supertokens?sslmode=disable && pnpm db:migrate-up
scripts.db:up: ../../tools/scripts/ensure_postgres_db.sh -d supertokens -c tactica_postgres_dev && ../../tools/scripts/ensure_postgres_user.sh -u supertokens -w supertokens_password -d supertokens -c tactica_postgres_dev
scripts.serve: docker rm -f supertokens 2>/dev/null; docker run --name supertokens -e POSTGRESQL_USER="supertokens" -e POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD="supertokens_password" -e POSTGRESQL_HOST="host.docker.internal" -e POSTGRESQL_PORT="5440" -e POSTGRESQL_DATABASE_NAME="supertokens" -e LOG_LEVEL="${LOG_LEVEL:-WARN}" -p 3567:3567 --rm registry.supertokens.io/supertokens/supertokens-postgresql:11.0.4
